seo_title: Find Computer Science Scholarships in the USA
seo_description: Computer Science scholarships in the USA: compare deadlines, award ranges, and requirements, then apply through each official program page.
intro: Trying to find USA scholarships for computer science can get messy fast, especially when programs sit under related labels like STEM, education, disability, medicine, or community. This filtered slice brings those rows into one place so you can apply with more focus, compare options that match your studies, and spot programs tied to computer and information sciences as well as nearby fields such as engineering, mathematics, or business. Awards, deadlines, and eligibility details vary across the listings below, and some opportunities appear to have lighter requirements than others. Because deadline text differs by row and some dates may be coming up soon, it is worth checking each listing promptly and verifying the official terms before you move forward.
h1: Compare Computer Science Scholarships in the USA
supporting: Use this list to compare more than just the scholarship title. Read the requirement lines closely, note the study level, and check whether a program is aimed at high school seniors, current college students, or graduate students. It also helps to compare category tags and residency labels so you can quickly separate broad STEM options from more specific computer science fits. Open the official page for any strong match, confirm the current award details, and keep a shortlist of the programs that best match your background.
related_intro: If you do not find enough strong matches here, related pages can help you widen the search by category, study level, or adjacent academic areas. That is useful when a computer science applicant also qualifies for broader STEM, engineering, education, disability, or community scholarships in the USA.

faq.question: How can I find Computer Science scholarships in the USA that fit my profile?
faq.answer: Use this filtered view to compare the rows by study level, field labels, and USA eligibility details such as U.S. citizen or U.S. permanent resident status. Then open the official source for each listing to verify current requirements, award details, and how to apply.

faq.question: Can I compare award amounts and deadlines on this Computer Science scholarships page?
faq.answer: Yes—these listings include award amounts and deadline text, but both vary by program. Amounts can range widely across the catalog, and deadlines differ by row, so check dates promptly and confirm everything on the official scholarship page.

faq.question: Are these only for current college students, or can I explore options at other study levels?
faq.answer: This filtered set includes programs tied to multiple study levels, with examples such as high school senior, college, and graduate student. Review each row carefully before you apply, since eligibility is set by the individual scholarship, not by the page as a whole.

faq.question: Do all Computer Science scholarships here require an essay?
faq.answer: No single requirement applies to every listing on this page. Some programs may have lighter application requirements while others may ask for essays or additional materials, so compare the rows and verify the application steps on official sources.

faq.question: What kinds of Computer Science scholarship themes show up in these listings?
faq.answer: Within this focused set, you may see Computer Science scholarships connected to broader categories like STEM, Education, Arts, Disability, Medicine, and Community. That makes it useful to browse and compare programs that match both your subject area and any category-specific fit.
